deals.headline: Evangelos Marinakis takes control of Nottingham Forest
deals.source_name: Companies House (PSC register, NF Football Investments Limited)
deals.summary: Companies House records Marinakis as controlling NF Football Investments Limited (75%+ shares and votes) from 10 February 2017; the accounts refer to 'investment from ownership since 2017'. Seller and price are not stated on these pages.

deals.headline: Control of Forest's holding company moved to Pittville One Limited
deals.summary: Pittville One Limited was the registered controller of NF Football Investments Limited from 29 April 2025 to 6 June 2025, after which Marinakis was again listed; reported as a UEFA multi-club compliance arrangement (not stated on this page).

deals.evidence: Ownership of shares – 75% or more with control over the trustees of a trust
deals.headline: Holding placed with a trust vehicle, then returned to Marinakis
deals.summary: Pittville Four Limited held 75%+ of NF Football Investments 'with control over the trustees of a trust' from 17 April 2026 to 10 June 2026; Marinakis was re-notified as person with significant control on 10 June 2026. Independent directors appointed to the club board in April 2026 left on 10 June 2026.

deals.summary: Related-party loans rose to £136.2m at 30 June 2025 (2024: £75.5m); the group says it depends on further loans from its ultimate beneficial owner.

name: Nottingham Forest Football Club
notes: Revenue is the group (NF Football Investments) turnover £223.0m for 2024-25; the club company's own KPI table gives £221.7m ('Turnover (£'000) 221,746'). The previous record's £222m via footballinsider247 was replaced. Turnover note also lists merchandising £10.1m, other commercial £29.1m and loan fees received £4.4m; these are not summed into a commercial figure. Forbes has no Forest team page (not in its 2026 list), and no other valuation was found. Founded 1865 is taken from the club site's footer ('Nottingham Forest FC 1865 - 2026'); the club's history pages render by JavaScript and could not be read. Chair/CEO not captured (club pages are JS-rendered); the 2017 purchase price and seller (Fawaz Al-Hasawi, reported) are not on a cited page; the reason for the Pittville trust arrangements (UEFA multi-club rules with Olympiacos) is reported, not stated on the registry. Honours, stadium ownership and social counts not found. Web search was unavailable for most of this run.

owners.evidence: The ultimate controlling party of NF Football Investments Limited is Mr E Marinakis.
owners.name: Evangelos Marinakis (via NF Football Investments Limited)

ownership_summary: Owned by Greek shipping owner Evangelos Marinakis through NF Football Investments Limited, which holds 75%+ of Nottingham Forest Football Club Limited and names Mr E Marinakis as its ultimate controlling party; he has been its registered controller since February 2017. To meet UEFA multi-club rules (he also owns Olympiacos) the holding was placed with trust vehicles twice (Pittville One Limited, April-June 2025; Pittville Four Limited, a trust, 17 April-10 June 2026); since 10 June 2026 Companies House again lists Marinakis directly as the person with significant control. The club is funded by owner and other loans.
revenue_source_name: NF Football Investments Limited group annual report and financial statements, year ended 30 June 2025 (Companies House)
stadium_capacity_evidence: It has a capacity of 31,212, although plans are in place to increase that to 52,500.
